title: Inland Revenue Ordinance
verified_how: Browser pane: https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap112. Title 'Cap. 112 Inland Revenue Ordinance'. Current version dated 22/05/2026.
notes: Covers salaries tax (Part III) and personal assessment. Hong Kong has no PAYE withholding. Employers only report under ss.52(4)-(7) (employer's returns and notice of cessation or departure), and s.52(7) lets the employer be required to withhold money from a departing employee.
